title: To Jane Mary Smith-Dampier

from-name: Charlotte Mary Yonge
to-name: To Jane Mary Smith-Dampier
manuscript-location: MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection

Dear [Mrs Dampier](/person/1345)
All good thanks and wishes.

Happy you.

Poor [Mrs Jones Bateman](/person/784).

Lloyd is rejoicing to go.

She is gone from home unable to stay alone

Yours affectionately

C M Yonge


[^1]: The letter presumably dates from after the arrival of the Jones-Batemans in Otterbourne in the 1870s.
